title: Interposer external I/O pad manifest (io_pads.json)
description: Governs the EXISTING io_pads.json sidecar (govern-what-exists; no new manifest). One schema, two frames, discriminated by the required 'frame' field: emitters (adk-tools chiplet_writer.write_io_pads_json, gds_to_kicad kicad_pcb_to_iopads.py) run in the pcbnew/GUI tier before any GDS exists and MUST emit frame=board_absolute_ynegated_um; the worker-tier canonicalizer (hyp_to_gds, which owns the GDS top-cell bbox) MUST re-emit the placed pads as frame=gds_bbox_corner_um next to the GDS, and that file is the only one a board-less consumer (Mosaic) may read. Structural validation only. Cross-field invariants checked by consumers/conformance, not here: ref uniqueness within io_pads; numeric rounding to 3 decimals; the leak guard (|x_um|,|y_um| > 1e5 in a gds_bbox_corner_um file indicates un-rebased coordinates, coord_frame_contract.md section 6.2). Self-discriminates from pins.json (top-level pins), the blackbox padmap (die+pads) and the adk boundary manifest (different schema const) via the schema const plus the top-level io_pads array.

schema.description: Artifact discriminator (boundary-manifest idiom). Doubles as cross-parse self-discrimination.

version.description: Contract version, quoted MAJOR.MINOR or MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Structural only: WHICH versions a consumer accepts is the shared version policy of docs/VERSION_POLICY.md (same major, minor at or below supported accepted; same-major higher minor accepted with a warning; different major refused; PATCH ignored), applied by chiplet_format_io.check_contract_version. Supported: 1.0. v1.0.0 IS the governed shape of the previously unversioned artifact, so the patch component stays writable and stays ignored.

frame.description: board_absolute_ynegated_um: KiCad-board-absolute, um, Y negated (Y-up); the only frame the pcbnew-tier emitters may produce, and the only frame hyp_to_gds --io-pads accepts. gds_bbox_corner_um: the canonical frame of coord_frame_contract.md section 6 (re-anchored to the interposer GDS top-cell bbox lower-left); produced only by the worker-tier canonicalizer, the only frame Mosaic-side checks accept. A consumer MUST hard-refuse a frame it does not expect; it never converts.

frame_origin_board_um.description: gds_bbox_corner_um files only: the canonical origin (GDS top-cell bbox lower-left) expressed in board_absolute_ynegated_um. Written by the canonicalizer as provenance; never compared.

io_pads.description: May be empty: the canonicalizer always writes the file (boundary-manifest precedent), so an empty array is the loud 'board yielded 0' signal, distinguishable from 'extraction never ran' (file absent).

ref.description: Footprint reference; the join key. Unique within the file (consumer-enforced). Maps to .chiplet io_pads[].id.

io_class.description: Closed vocabulary, mirroring the .chiplet field: the die-side USAGE class of the pad (how it is attached), not the interposer-side pad geometry class, which lives in the PDK as pad_classes and is joined through the interconnect method. Closed on 2026-09-05 to the set every governed emitter already enforces (KiCad exporter, plugin writer, studio); adding a value is a MINOR bump adopted by consumers before any producer emits it.

x_um.description: Pad geometric center X in the file's frame, um, rounded to 3 decimals.

y_um.description: Pad geometric center Y in the file's frame, um, rounded to 3 decimals.

size_x_um.description: A pad whose size cannot be determined is an emitter ERROR, never a 0.0 entry and never a silent drop.

net.description: May be empty: a no-net pad is legal (interposer-pnr treats it as an unattached diagnostic).

layer.description: PDK layer name the pad geometry is rendered on (e.g. TopMetal2), matching the .chiplet io_pads[].layer domain. NEVER a KiCad board layer name; that goes in source_layer.

source_layer.description: Optional provenance: the KiCad board layer (e.g. F.Cu). Never compared.
